text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm, fufu! Now then, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. You were watching when 
Pokke and I were practicing acting before, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A few girls from the Ritto Dorm were in 
that audience, and they asked if they 
could put on a play of their own with me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I organized a play as a dorm event, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The cast is full of distinct personalities 
like Opera O, Sweep, Kawakami, and Gimlet. 
I've been pondering which script would 
suit them best.
choice_data_list: How about a fairytale with a princess?
An adventure story with a hero might fit!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A fairytale, huh? Classic and solid! I can 
already picture the casting. Alright, I'll 
go look for a script right away!

A short while later, the day of the 
performance arrived. Heading to the 
specially opened multipurpose room on 
campus, the curtain rose on the 
one-day-only stage—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my fair Prince! I am the one who 
dropped the glass slipper! Please believe 
me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nay, it is not thee! The maiden who stole 
my heart that night possessed eyes as 
clear and blue as a sacred spring!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Clear blue eyes...? You must have seen 
wrong. Come now, Prince—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Prince...! Even beneath the sunlight, 
you are simply magnificent~~~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What business does a scullery maid have 
here!? Go away! Shoo, shoo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What if you get dust all over the Prince?! 
Have you finished laundering the dress 
yet?! You fixed the frayed hem too, didn't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The stepmother queen and the 
selfish stepsister are showing zero mercy. 
Even Kawakami is totally looking down in 
the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I cast them specifically to make it look 
that way. A lot of the staff and actors 
are doing this for the first time, so I 
decided based on their personalities and 
aptitudes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Which is why I'm on lighting, huh. 
Well, that makes sense~ Someone like me 
only exists to shine the spotlight on 
others anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think... I assigned you to 
lighting just because nobody else wanted 
to do it, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh, well, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is just my personal philosophy, but 
making someone else shine takes far more 
skill than simply shining on your own.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I knew that you would illuminate the stage 
better than anyone else. That's why I 
entrusted it to you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Geez, saying stuff like that! Don't 
come crying to me if you flatter me too 
much and it goes straight to my head!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, how elegant! It is just like a 
princess's transformation scene~~~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Excellent!! Ah, Iris who illuminates the 
stage! Thank you for bestowing your 
blessings upon us!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And now... You, whom the glass slipper 
fits so flawlessly, are without a doubt 
the princess I have been searching for!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come with me to the castle. Let us hold a 
grand banquet! My beloved princess!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming to watch! Did 
you enjoy the show?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a wonderful smile! Everyone who 
took part in the play seemed thoroughly 
fulfilled as well.

The play was far more captivating than I 
had imagined. Such quality was surely 
because Fuji Kiseki was at the helm. 
However—
choice_data_list:
I was surprised you didn't perform 
yourself.

I was surprised you didn't perform 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it might seem that way. However, 
acting as both director and stage manager 
was something I decided right from the 
moment I planned the play.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As the dorm head of the Ritto Dormitory, I 
wanted all the participants to truly enjoy 
the production— That's why I dedicated 
myself entirely behind the scenes, where I 
could look over the whole picture.
choice_data_list:
I think that makes you a splendid 
entertainer too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san! Indeed, 
entertainers come in all sorts of forms.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An adventure story, huh? That's great, it 
leaves plenty of room for creative 
arrangements! I'm already getting an image 
for the casting. All right, I'll go look 
for a script right away!

Some time later, the day of the 
performance arrived. Heading to the 
specially opened multipurpose room on 
campus, the curtain rose on the 
one-day-only stage—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Guh... A barrier that even my secret 
ultimate art cannot shatter! Is this the 
power of Hades, King of the 
Underworld...?!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I have sealed you within the 
cage of chaos summoned from my dark realm. 
Even the techniques of the hero are no 
match!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the tragedy of it all!! If I, the 
Hero, should fall, what will become of 
this world...?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for real? That's acting? They're 
actkin' way too normal, it's killin' me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I cast them specifically so that would 
happen. I picked a flexible script to let 
everyone's distinct individuality shine 
through.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Asking you to handle sound effects was 
part of that plan, Helios. So please, feel 
free to run wild with it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Fuji's casting is straight-up 
God tier, hype max! Freestyle order 
received and appreciated! Let's pump up 
the vibes~~~!! Yeaaah☆

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, bwaaa-hahahaha!! I am intoxicated! 
I am driven to frenzy!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The time is ripe. O heroes 
dispatched by the Three Goddesses of 
Destiny, I shall personally grant you your 
demise!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Charon, Styx, Lethe... Vanish into the 
depths of oblivion!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Blow, O winds. Carry forth the seeds. 
Sprout and bud, sing praise to life. 
Gather, O light, weave a ladder, and show 
us hope!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I reversed and nullified your grand magic! 
When it comes to magic, nobody beats me! 
If you wanna defeat the hero, you'll have 
to get through me first!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see, she is a mage who governs both 
darkness and light! She achieved awakening 
through a melody praising the Underworld 
King! We have a chance at victory! Fight 
on!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Pledge, Four, Grenadine... Be utterly 
consumed by the season of death!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Turn, O clock. Awaken, O earth. Pierce 
through, pierce through the ceiling of 
frost and snow. Cycle through the eternal 
ring and bring forth spring!

Delivering their lines in rhythm with the 
music, the scene built up excitement akin 
to a rap battle. As the incantation duel 
concluded, applause erupted from the 
audience.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A beautiful poem. Very well. In 
homage to your aesthetic, I shall halt the 
invasion of the surface realm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You weren't half bad yourself. Let's have 
another incantation match sometime. That 
way, you won't be lonely anymore!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Excellent!! To have achieved 
reconciliation with Hades, King of the 
Underworld! With this, the world is saved. 
A magnificent happy ending!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming to watch! Did 
you enjoy the show?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a wonderful smile! Everyone who 
took part in the play seemed thoroughly 
fulfilled as well.

The play was far more captivating than I 
had imagined. Such quality was surely 
because Fuji Kiseki was at the helm. 
However—
choice_data_list:
I was surprised you didn't perform 
yourself.

I was surprised you didn't perform 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it might seem that way. However, 
acting as both director and stage manager 
was something I decided right from the 
moment I planned the play.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As the dorm head of the Ritto Dormitory, I 
wanted all the participants to truly enjoy 
the production— That's why I dedicated 
myself entirely behind the scenes, where I 
could look over the whole picture.
choice_data_list:
I think that makes you a splendid 
entertainer too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Entertainers come in many 
forms— Through this experience with Pokke 
and everyone in the dorm, I came to 
realize that anew.
